description: This Java source file defines the UndoWithdrawalCommandHandler class, which handles commands to undo withdrawal actions in the client portfolio module of the project. It implements a command handler interface, is annotated with Spring annotations for service and transaction management, and interacts with the ClientWritePlatformService to perform the undo operation.

classes.name: UndoWithdrawalCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class implementing the command handler to process undo withdrawal commands for clients.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the undo withdrawal command by delegating to the ClientWritePlatformService.undoWithdrawal method.
